openSource.title: Adapters are open source

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Pick a plan by monthly call volume. Change plans any time. Prices exclude 7% VAT.

count.a: One call is one tool invocation by your AI, whether served from cache or the live source. Calls rejected for invalid input don't count.

overQuota.q: What happens if I go over quota?
overQuota.a: We alert you at 80%. Beyond the quota, calls return rate_limited until the next billing period. You're never charged extra automatically.

byok.a: Some sources, such as Thailand Post and LINE OA, need a key from your own account. We store it encrypted and only use it to call on your behalf.

data.q: Do you store what the AI sends?
data.a: We keep each call's input and output for your plan's retention period so you can review it, then delete it automatically. You can delete history at any time.

selfHost.a: Yes. All adapters are open source on GitHub. The hosted service suits teams that don't want to run servers, quotas, caching and credentials themselves.

invoice.q: Do you issue Thai tax invoices?
invoice.a: Yes. Full tax invoices are issued monthly on the Usage & plan page.
